title: Day14 Tech Radar
purpose: Delta baseline for the weekly tech scan. Anything listed here is SETTLED — the scan must not re-report it as new. Mirrored from the vault note 'Tech Radar.md'; the vault note is the human source of truth, this file is the machine-readable copy a headless cloud session can fetch without the device bridge.
schema_2_notes: Schema 2 is additive only — every ring item still carries `item`, so any reader that matches on names is unaffected. New optional per-item fields: `slug` (stable id), `capability` (the vault capability note behind it), `next_action` (the one concrete step that would advance it), `effort`, `blocked_by`, and `in_production_since` (null = not running; absent = nobody has verified). `in_production_since` is what rule 1 is checked against, so an Adopt entry without it is flagged rather than trusted. `blocked_by` means the next_action CANNOT be started yet because it waits on something else — it is not a restatement of the next action, and setting it wrongly buries cheap work at the bottom of the queue. Enforced in src/lib/tech-radar.ts and surfaced at /dashboard/ai.
rules_for_changing_a_ring: An item moves to Adopt only after it has run in production for a full week without intervention.
An item in Hold requires NEW EVIDENCE to move, not a new opinion. Cite the evidence.
Adding an item requires it to be shipping (not announced), to change a Day14 decision, and to be absent from every ring below.
Removing an item requires recording why in the changelog array, never a silent delete.

adopt.why: External alarm that fires on silence; the only design that survives the mini being the thing that died.
adopt.status: Built 2026-07-27, NOT armed — awaiting two Jack taps.
adopt.next_action: Create the check at healthchecks.io and paste its ping URL into the fleet-deadman env var. Two taps, then it is real.

adopt.item: Cloudflare AI Gateway spend limits + Dynamic Route fallback
adopt.why: Dollar-denominated budgets, free, auto-downgrade instead of hard stop. Caveats: best-effort cost estimation, limit-hit notification still in development.
adopt.status: Decided, not wired — the LLM layer still calls providers directly.
adopt.next_action: Point the patched LLM layer's base URL at the gateway and set the dollar cap. Verify one call lands in the gateway's log before trusting the cap.

adopt.item: Official ads MCP servers (Meta / Google / TikTok)
adopt.why: Makes Marque operationally real. Meta entities land paused by default, which satisfies the no-money-without-a-Jack-tap guardrail for free.
adopt.status: Evaluated only — no account is connected.
adopt.next_action: Connect Google first (read-only by design, so it cannot spend) and confirm one real read before touching Meta or TikTok.

adopt.why: No-code, ~2 min, no premium, supports subscriptions and Tax. The block is almost certainly an account restriction, not code.
adopt.status: BLOCKED — zero working checkout links across 12 SKUs since June.
adopt.next_action: Open the Stripe dashboard and look for an account restriction notice. Do not write more checkout code until that question is answered.

trial.why: Best 24GB Apple Silicon tool-calling pick. Turns total blackout into degraded mode.
trial.status: Code shipped; Ollama is not installed on the mini, so there is currently no degraded mode at all.
trial.next_action: brew install ollama && ollama pull mistral-small3.2:24b on the mini. The fallback leg is already in code and inert until the model answers.

trial.status: Wired but INERT — the stable preamble is ~300 tokens, below the 2048-token minimum, so no cache can ever hit.
trial.next_action: Grow the stable agent prefix past 2048 tokens, then re-measure cache reads in the ledger. Until the prefix grows this is a no-op, not a saving.

trial.why: agent_id / run_id / org_id composed at retrieval. Reported gains cluster on temporal (+29.6) and multi-hop (+23.1) reasoning — the 'did we already do this' faculty.
trial.next_action: Build agent_id/run_id/org_id scoping at retrieval time. This is the direct fix for the pathology that produced 253 briefs in 10 days.

trial.why: Score one thing: did this run cause a state change outside its own log directory? Auto-pause loops that score zero.
trial.status: Shipped 2026-07-27 to scripts/lib/loop-gate.mjs; selftests passing; 7 loops seeded.
trial.next_action: Leave it running and do not touch it. The Adopt clock is on the card; rule 1's production week is the only thing between it and the Adopt ring.

assess.why: Breaking: handshake removed, Mcp-Session-Id gone, Tasks API demoted, error -32002 to -32602, JSON Schema 2020-12. The spec date has now passed.
assess.next_action: Audit scripts/mcp-server.mjs against the five breaking changes. This is dated work, not optional reading — the spec date is behind us.

assess.item: Per-agent effort levels + new webhook events (Managed Agents 2026-07-22)
assess.why: Coordinator high, subagents low. Direct cost lever across a 27-daemon fleet.
assess.next_action: Set subagent effort to low in the fleet's agent config and compare a week of ledger cost against the current week.

assess.item: Claude Managed Agents self-hosted sandboxes + MCP Tunnels
assess.why: Outbound-only gateway to private MCP servers; would retire the admin-tunnel runbook. Public beta 2026-05-19.
assess.next_action: Read the tunnel docs and decide whether it replaces the admin-tunnel runbook. Do not build against a public beta until that call is made.

assess.why: Zero-markup multi-provider routing with virtual-key budgets. Real ops burden; Cloudflare covers it at $0 until volume justifies.
assess.next_action: Nothing until Cloudflare AI Gateway is actually wired and its estimation-only cost tracking has been measured against a real invoice.
assess.blocked_by: Cloudflare AI Gateway is not wired yet, so there is no comparison to make.

assess.why: Credible OSS fallback when Retell/Vapi margin gets squeezed.
assess.next_action: Nothing until there is a paying voice customer whose margin is being squeezed.
assess.blocked_by: No voice customers — the margin play has no margin to protect yet.

assess.why: One endpoint to ~100 models for client-site AI features. Delivery-cost lever, not a revenue lever.
Dedups near-identical queries beyond prefix caching. Only after prompt caching is measured.
assess.blocked_by: Prompt caching has never fired, so there is no baseline to improve on.

assess.why: Conversationally provision per-client billing. Useful once there are clients.
assess.blocked_by: Checkout does not work yet. After checkout, not before.

hold.item: Agentic commerce (ACP, AP2, x402, Visa Trusted Agent, Mastercard Agent Pay)
hold.reason: OpenAI KILLED Instant Checkout March 2026; ACP forward-dated; AP2 at FIDO; x402 ~$28k/day at $0.20 avg with ~half wash; card networks enterprise-pilot only. No agent can buy Day14's service on any protocol today.
8.7% adoption of Tranco top-1,000 but zero evidence any major crawler parses it; a 500-site analysis found zero correlation. Keep the file as hygiene; remove it from the pitch.
hold.revisit: on a crawler vendor publicly confirming support

hold.reason: No independent validation exists for any of them, including Higgsfield's own predictor. Internal heuristic only, never a customer-facing claim.
Kling 3.0 Elo 1104 vs Veo 3.1 1094 is noise; every competitor reaches the same models through the same wrappers at ~$1-2/clip. Bottleneck is creative volume and fatigue management, not model choice.
hold.revisit: on a step-change, not a leaderboard swap

hold.item: Open-source ai-visibility repos as a GEO product base
hold.reason: Star counts and naming patterns look farmed; self-descriptions read as marketing. Read for architecture, do not build on.
No breakout durable-execution project with credible traction; Temporal's agent positioning is roadmap language. The problem is loops with no success criterion, not orchestration mechanics.
hold.revisit: on a framework with production case studies

hold.reason: Reply rates ~3.43% and sender-auth tightening are real but irrelevant: zero emails sent in 31 days is an effort problem, not a tooling problem.

changelog.note: Radar created from the full landscape scan. Seeded 4 Adopt, 4 Trial, 8 Assess, 7 Hold.

Schema 2. Added stable slugs, capability links, next_action/effort/blocked_by, and in_production_since so rule 1 is checkable instead of assumed. No ring changed. Recording the first honest reading: all four Adopt entries have in_production_since null — decided or built, none running — so the Adopt ring is currently empty in substance. Surfaced at /dashboard/ai.
